## Related Issue / 关联 Issue

<!--
For example: Closes #12. If there is no related Issue, write “None” and explain why.

例如：Closes #12；若没有关联 Issue，请写“无”并说明原因。

## Change Type / 变更类型

- [ ] feat: Feature / 新增功能
- [ ] fix: Bug fix / 漏洞修复
- [ ] docs: Documentation / 文档更新
- [ ] refactor: Refactoring / 代码重构
- [ ] perf: Performance improvement / 性能优化
- [ ] test: Tests / 测试相关
- [ ] build: Build or dependency changes / 构建或依赖修改
- [ ] ci: CI/CD configuration / CI/CD 配置
- [ ] chore: Other maintenance / 其他维护工作
- [ ] revert: Revert / 回退提交

## Self-Review Checklist / 自查清单

- [ ] I have read and followed the applicable requirements in [AI Agent Development Guidelines](https://github.com/XAUFE-CA/.github/blob/main/COLLABORATION.md#1-ai-agent-开发规范) and [AI-Assisted Collaboration Guidelines](https://github.com/XAUFE-CA/.github/blob/main/COLLABORATION.md#2-ai-辅助协作规范). / 已阅读并遵守 [AI Agent 开发规范](https://github.com/XAUFE-CA/.github/blob/main/COLLABORATION.md#1-ai-agent-开发规范) 与 [AI 辅助协作规范](https://github.com/XAUFE-CA/.github/blob/main/COLLABORATION.md#2-ai-辅助协作规范) 中的适用要求。
- [ ] I have confirmed that the change scope matches this task and contains no unrelated files. / 变更范围与本次目标一致，未包含无关文件。
- [ ] I have accurately reported the verification performed and have not fabricated test or review evidence. / 已如实填写验证方式，未伪造测试或审查证据。
- [ ] I have not included credentials, private keys, personal information, or other sensitive data. / 未提交凭据、私钥、个人隐私数据或其他敏感内容。
- [ ] If `profile/assets/` snapshots are involved, I confirmed they are genuine generator output and were not edited manually. / 涉及 `profile/assets/` 快照时，已确认其为生成器真实输出而非手工改写。
- [ ] If I changed wording in community health files (`CONTRIBUTING.md`, `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`, `SECURITY.md`), I explained why. / 修改社区健康文件（`CONTRIBUTING.md`、`CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`、`SECURITY.md`）措辞时，已说明必要性。
